metadata.description: The JMM's Chmpai Soren won a test of strength in the Jharkhand Assembly today. The Champai Soren-led government won the floor test after getting 47 votes in the 81-member assembly. JMM leader and former Jharkhand chief minister Hemant Soren was present in the assembly in Ranchi to take part in the trust vote. A special court in Ranchi has allowed Hemant Soren, the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM) executive president, to participate in the floor test. Watch this ground report.
